text: {"lessons":["Five consecutive periods of losses show that holding without a plan can let declines compound; review positions and set clear reasons for holding or selling.","Avoid reacting to short-term moves alone—monthly changes are noisy, so make decisions based on a consistent long-term process.","With no company or market information beyond prices, I should avoid pretending I can predict returns; preserve cash and take measured risks rather than trading for its own sake."]}
